description: This file defines a REST controller for the checkout process in a Java Spring-based e-commerce application. It handles HTTP POST requests to create an order from a shopping cart, involving validation, interaction with business logic, and returning a structured response.

classes.name: CheckoutController
classes.description: REST controller for checkout operations, enabling order creation from cart in a phase 1 checkout flow.

methods.name: createOrderFromCart
methods.description: Handles POST request to create an order from a shopping cart, invokes business logic, and returns a response with order details.
